title: RPG Maker VX Ace remains loaded on background after closing it

posts.author: Marco4556
posts.body:
Hello everybody.
I recently bought RPG Maker VX Ace on steam and I found an annoying bug. When I close RMVXA with a project open, I can notice that discord's saying that I'm using the software... but I close it! I check the task manager and, actually, RPG Maker VX Ace is running on background.
I've do anything: reinstalling VX Ace and the Standard resource but nothing. Is there anyone that knows how to fix this
Thanks!

posts.author: Heirukichi
posts.body:
Are you, by any change, synchronizing your game data on Steam Cloud? If you do, it uploads the whole database each time, and that is quite the long process.
You can disable Steam Cloud synchronization for VX Ace or run the engine in offline mode. Either solution should solve your problem.
